clarity.notes: Session notices now read as neutral operator chrome with signal only on icons/pills; titles and body no longer compete in the same hue.

hierarchy.notes: Alert title = small-body/fg-strong; description = form-input/muted; meta = eyebrow/subtle. ThinkingBlock label uses form-label medium instead of italic wash.

typography.notes: Aligned to DESIGN.md type roles (small-body, form-input, form-label, eyebrow). Markdown links are fg-strong with accent on hover only.

motion.notes: No new motion; existing ThinkingBlock chevron/hover transitions unchanged and still respect reduced-motion.

brand.notes: Matches web/CLAUDE.md signal rule (information, not solid semantic banners) and Synara/T3 restrained chrome: neutral surface, hairline border, icon-only signal.
